blocks.text: OAS, ALBAY, Philippines — The municipal government of Oas launched its digitalization program Tuesday (Nov. 17), offering online services aimed at reducing bureaucratic processes and helping residents save time and money by eliminating the need for in-person transactions at municipal offices. The digital platform provides access to various municipal services, including business permit registration and renewal, Medilink Health and Appointment, real property tax (RPT) billing, treasury transactions, and building permits and certificates of occupancy. Mayor John Kenneth Trinidad said the initiative forms part of the municipality’s efforts to harness technology to deliver basic and frontline services more efficiently. READ: Over 940 LGUs use […]...
